name: Consolidator
description: Aggregates finalized, start-stamped, aligned fixed-duration source bars into left-closed/right-open higher-timeframe UTC or timezone-aligned bars. Emits after aggregating a source bar whose inferred end reaches the target end. If the terminal source bar is missing, the next bucket's input releases the previous observed aggregate first. Input-driven only; final bars are not flushed.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: Historical OHLCV (time/timestamp) or live compact OHLCV (t/o/h/l/c/v).

fields.label: Timezone
fields.description: Optional IANA timezone used for bucket alignment and DST.

output.description: Every successful execution propagates. Held or duplicate inputs return emitted=false with workingBar. Immediate completion returns emitted=true with bar and workingBar representing the same completed bucket; rollover fallback returns the previous bar and a new workingBar. Gate completed-bar-only branches with an If node checking emitted == true.
